module_hints.description: Linux kernel Bluetooth subsystem (L2CAP, HCI, SMP, RFCOMM)
module_hints.notes: Complex state machine with multiple protocol layers. Channels can be in various states (BT_LISTEN, BT_CONNECTED, BT_CONFIG). Many vulnerabilities are in packet parsing where length fields from remote devices are trusted without validation. Use klee_assume to constrain state machine to reachable states. HCI events arrive via hci_event_packet() dispatcher.
